results.question: Dali je netko u zadnjih 7 dana spomenuo PHP?
results.sql:
SELECT m.id, m.content, m.created_at
FROM nb_messages m
JOIN nb_conversations c ON m.conversation_id = c.id
WHERE c.owner_id = :owner_id
  AND c.updated_at >= :retention_cutoff
  AND m.role = 'user'
  AND m.status = 'complete'
  AND m.created_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND m.content LIKE '%PHP%'
LIMIT 20;

results.question: Prikaži pitanja posjetitelja od jučer koja spominju cijenu.
results.sql:
SELECT m.id, m.content, m.created_at
FROM nb_messages m
JOIN nb_conversations c ON m.conversation_id = c.id
WHERE c.owner_id = :owner_id
  AND c.updated_at >= :retention_cutoff
  AND m.role = 'user'
  AND m.status = 'complete'
  AND m.created_at >= '2026-10-14 22:00:00'
  AND m.created_at <  '2026-10-15 22:00:00'
  AND m.content LIKE '%cijenu%'
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

results.question: Koliko je poruka posjetitelja bilo u zadnjih 30 dana?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS visitor_message_count
FROM nb_messages m
JOIN nb_conversations c ON m.conversation_id = c.id
WHERE c.owner_id = :owner_id
  AND c.updated_at >= :retention_cutoff
  AND m.role = 'user'
  AND m.status = 'complete'
  AND m.created_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
LIMIT 20
